description: Sovereign Capital Allocation Cockpit — v1.1.0-AAA Honest Wiring. Capital allocation evaluated against 13 thermodynamic primitives, with cross-organ contradiction scan and VAULT999 readiness surface. v1.1.0 fixes the phantom tool names from v1.0.0 and locks the F10 verdict grammar.

geox_contradiction_scan.rationale: Contradiction detection is a GEOX responsibility. Capital Judge consumes, never duplicates.

arifos_judge_proxy.rationale: Capital verdicts are advisory. arifOS retains constitutional judgment authority.

verdict_grammar.rationale: Capital allocation outcomes are not constitutional verdicts. SEAL/SABAR/VOID are reserved for arifOS kernel. HOLD is too generic for capital domain. 888-HOLD is the only sovereign-pause state and routes to VAULT999.

thirteen_capital_primitives.rationale: 13 primitives are the WEALTH capital thermodynamic surface per /root/wiki/domains/wealth.md. v1.0.0 only exposed 5 (NPV, IRR, DSCR, PI, Payback). v1.1.0 surfaces all 13.

vault_readiness.rationale: Capital Judge proposes VAULT999 entries only. Writes go through arifOS jarir_seal pipeline, never directly from the app. 888-HOLD is the only state that triggers a proposal.

audit_link.rationale: Every judgment execution writes a capital_ledger entry. F11 AUDIT satisfied.

receipt_policy.rationale: Salam Receipt v1 and Scar Ledger v1 are not canonical artifacts in the federation. The real receipt surface is VAULT999, which Capital Judge can only propose (never directly write).

verdict_states.QUALIFY: Project meets financial and sovereign criteria.
verdict_states.REJECT: Value destruction or ethical breach detected.
verdict_states.888-HOLD: Critical leverage or dignity flags require human intervention before proceeding.

changelog.1.0.0-AAA: Initial release with 5-dimension UI and phantom tool references in manifest.
changelog.1.1.0-AAA: Reconcile required_tools with real capital_* modes. Lock verdict grammar. Add wizard_mode, cross_organ_dependencies, thirteen_capital_primitives, vault_readiness, audit_link, receipt_policy. No runtime code changes in this release — manifest hardening only.
